
## llm_machineA_2026-11-07.tar.gz
Ollama (qwen2.5:14b) response cache from machine A's label run, 12,558 files, stopped by Kent on 2026-11-07 during Department of Public Schools. The run wrote it to `src/data/cache/llm/` by mistake (relative path after `setwd(src)`). To resume: `tar xzf data/cache/llm_machineA_2026-11-07.tar.gz -C data/cache` so the files land in `data/cache/llm/`. That folder is gitignored; the tarball is the committed copy.
